VA Careers - Pharmacy: https://youtube.com/embed/Fn_ickNBEws The Pharmacy Program Manager (Pharmacoeconomics/Formulary Management) is responsible for leading and coordinating pharmacoeconomic programs, formulary management activities, and cost-containment initiatives across VA North Texas.

Their scope spans Program Management, Administrative & Quality Assurance, Research & Education, Clinical Practice, and Communication. A. Program Management Leads cost-containment strategies, formulary maintenance, drug utilization reviews, and pharmacoeconomic research. Evaluates new medications for budget impact and formulary considerations.

Oversees cost-efficient use of high-cost or high-risk medications and may serve as approval authority. Conducts drug use evaluations, tracks KPIs, analyzes trends, and implements improvement plans. Manages Prior Authorization Drug Requests, therapeutic interchange activities, formulary reviews, and formulary change processes.

Develops medication criteria for use and tools to measure outcomes of formulary and pharmacoeconomic interventions. Collaborates on drug shortages, recalls, adverse drug event monitoring, and REMS activities. B. Administrative and Quality Assurance Performs data analytics using tools such as SQL, Power BI, Pyramid, and Excel.

Maintains pharmacoeconomic resources and references. Participates in quality improvement initiatives, policy development, and P&T Committee activities (facility and VISN). Ensures drug file accuracy and provides consultation on drug procurement, cost analysis, and patient care.

Documents cost-avoidance activities and supports performance measure achievement. C. Research and Education Supports trainee education and provides preceptorship in pharmacoeconomics and research. Coordinates clinical research, outcomes studies, and real-world evidence assessments.

Educates staff and providers on formulary management, guidelines, and cost-effective drug use. Contributes to VISN and national PBM research and drug utilization evaluation initiatives. Completes required training and supports staff development. D.

Clinical Reviews medication regimens for safety, effectiveness, dosing, interactions, and therapeutic outcomes. Monitors and reports drug errors, adverse reactions, allergies, and compliance. Applies laboratory interpretation skills for dose adjustments and patient assessment.

Monitors high-risk and high-cost medication use and formulary adherence using dashboards. Identifies misuse, inappropriate dosing, duplications, interactions, suboptimal response, and deprescribing opportunities. Provides cost-effective therapeutic recommendations and pharmacokinetic guidance.

Serves as a drug information resource and documents clinical interventions. E. Communication Maintains effective relationships with providers, nursing staff, and other departments. Serves as an authoritative resource to resolve medication-related questions and ensures positive communication experiences.

Work Schedule: Monday-Friday, between 7am- 5pm /8 hour work schedule); Tour may be adjusted or extended to meet patient care needs. Telework: Not Available Virtual: This is not a virtual position.

Aufgaben
Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für laufende Bauvorhaben im Bereich MSR und Gebäudeautomation. Dabei steuern und koordinieren Sie Mitarbeitende, Nachunternehmer, Material und Abläufe und sorgen dafür, dass Qualität, Termine und Ergebnisse zusammenpassen.

The Healthcare Career Advancement Program ( H-CAP ) is a national labor/management organization that promotes innovation and quality in healthcare career education. We
build the workforce for quality care through workforce development, training resources, and partnering for patients and communities.
H-CAP works with employers, unions, and workers to deploy high-quality training to support the healthcare industry at a time of unprecedented system transformation. These training programs seek to lift up workers, create a pipeline of well-trained staff for employers, and ensure that healthcare continues to fulfill its promise as a primary engine of the economy, both nationally and locally.
H-CAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to maintaining a diverse staff and encourage applications from people of color, women, people with disabilities, the LGBTQ+ community, and other applicants whose background or lived experiences may contribute to our mission of building equitable, quality jobs and education in the healthcare field.
Our organizational values, Accountability, Collaboration, Leadership, and our Worker-Centric & Equity focus, are important to us and guide the impactful work we do here at H-CAP . A successful candidate for this position will demonstrate the following qualities in their role:
Accountability shows up when we exercise continuous self-awareness, ownership, and responsibility for our words, ideas, and actions.
Collaboration shows up when we build powerful diverse relationships and inclusive teams that ensure open communication at all levels and create new pathways for solutions jointly.
Leadership shows up when we organize others around a vision, inspire each other to learn from our successes and failures, take initiative and courageous action.
Worker-Centric/Equity shows up when we center the experiences and voices of workers and continually examine and advance policies, practices, and systems for racial/gender justice and job quality, with those most impacted at the center.
Reports to: Associate Director

H-CAP is seeking a full-time Program Manager to support the development, implementation, and expansion of H-CAP ’s Registered Apprenticeship Program within the healthcare industry. This position will work collaboratively with employers, education partners, labor-management organizations, unions and other stakeholders to advance registered apprenticeship opportunities and strengthen healthcare workforce development initiatives.
The Program Manager will lead outreach and engagement efforts, provide support to partners developing and implementing registered apprenticeship programs, and coordinate educational activities, including webinars, forums, career fairs, and trainings. The position will work closely with the Registered Apprenticeship team and the broader H-CAP team to meet programmatic and organizational goals.
This role requires the ability to develop work plans and goals, participate effectively in a collaborative organizational environment, and exercise discretion and independent judgment. The ideal candidate will be a proactive, highly organized professional with a strong commitment to advancing H-CAP ’s mission and meeting contract and grant goals.

Outreach, Recruitment, and Partner Engagement
Coordinate and conduct outreach to prospective partners interested in pursuing Registered Apprenticeship programs, including communicating the value of Registered Apprenticeship in healthcare.
Develop and implement outreach and recruitment strategies to reach a variety of stakeholders, accelerate Registered Apprenticeship expansion, and increase opportunities in apprenticeship occupations.
Conduct informational sessions in a variety of formats for various stakeholders.
Communications and Marketing Support
Identify needs and lead the creation of materials that support Registered Apprenticeship outreach.
Work with H-CAP ’s Data and Communications team to amplify Registered Apprenticeship promotional and marketing efforts as directed by H-CAP leadership.
Grant Compliance, Tracking, and Reporting
Develop, maintain, and submit outreach plans and track deliverables to ensure compliance with grant and contract obligations.
Enter accurate and timely data into a variety of tracking systems.
Gather data and write reports on progress.
Registered Apprenticeship Program Support
Build multi-employer apprenticeship programs in multiples states and occupations
Support partners in the development and implementation of Registered Apprenticeship programs.
Support the work of the SEIU/AFSCME National Center for Healthcare Apprenticeships.
Industry Knowledge and Organizational Collaboration
Stay current on healthcare workforce development, training trends, and changes affecting the healthcare industry.
Work with the H-CAP team to develop and implement programs and activities that support board members and the H-CAP Education Association.
Work closely with staff and leadership of labor-management programs.

Project Management and Coordination
A minimum of 5 years of project management experience.
Excellent project coordination and organizational skills, with the ability to work independently.
Experience working in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.
Industry and Workforce Knowledge
Knowledge of the healthcare industry and workforce development.
Knowledge of Registered Apprenticeship and the Registered Apprenticeship System
Experience working with large and small healthcare employers in the development of workforce development programs
Experience with post-secondary education and adult education programs.
Communication and Presentation
Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills.
Ability and comfort presenting to a variety of audiences using a mix of methods, including virtual and in-person formats.
Labor-Management and Stakeholder Engagement
Work experience or familiarity with union or labor-management environments.
Existing connections with stakeholders such as healthcare employers, industry associations, unions, labor-management organizations, workforce boards, and education partners.
Grant Development and Data Systems
Experience with grant writing and grant reporting
Experience with database systems and the ability to learn new systems quickly.

* Attend field visits together with the key account managers with customers
* Attend congresses and networking events

* Business fluent in German, English and ideally French

* Driven, passionate, ambitious
* Keen on maximize AbbVie success through professional Market Access work
* Keep one step ahead of changes and have a good sense of the future of the Brands.
* Team player and work well in a matrix organization to share insights and to develop the propositions

L-Hôpital Riviera-Chablais, Vaud-Valais (HRC), est un hôpital intercantonal de référence, qui réunit plus de 2-500 collaboratrices et collaborateurs. Le Centre hospitalier de Rennaz, compte plus de 350 lits de soins aigus. Il est complété par deux Cliniques de gériatrie et réadaptation ainsi que deux permanences médicales.

L-ensemble des collaboratrices et collaborateurs s-investissent au quotidien pour fournir une prise en charge de qualité aux patient·e·s, en incarnant les valeurs de l-institution : l-authenticité, l-exemplarité et l-innovation.
La Direction du Développement Organisationnel a pour mission de piloter les projets institutionnels, d'optimiser l'organisation et les flux, et de renforcer la qualité et l'expérience patient au sein de l'Hôpital Riviera-Chablais.
Composée d'expert·e·s en gestion de projet, ingénierie organisationnelle, amélioration continue et management de la qualité, elle accompagne les équipes dans la mise en œuvre de solutions concrètes pour améliorer la performance opérationnelle et le parcours patient.
